text.p: These are the leading storiesin the Egyptian press on Sunday.Reuters has not verified these storiesand does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Palestinian Authority to form national committees to defend Gaza Strip and West Bank from new wave of Jewish settlements -- calls on Palestinians to defend their land and rights.
- In opinion poll on personalities of the year, Mubarak wins man of the year and Suzanne Mubarak is woman of the year.
- Ganzouri tells political club of the National Democratic Party that government will sell New Delta land to private sector.
- People's Assembly approves lifting of tax and duties on end of service benefits.
- Tourism returns to Sinai, Hurghada and Luxor.
- Washington Times says Egypt is the ideal place for attracting foreign investors. Says Mubarak and government's dialogue with private sector creates work opportunities.
- Two terrorists killed during shootout with police on train in Sohag province. Three policemen martyred and six others wounded in terrorist attack in Minya province.
- Board of directors in loss-incurring construction companies to be changed.
- Floods destroy 1413 houses in Qena and 500 in Hurghada.
- Youssef Wali says Egypt will produce 8.5 million Kentar of raw cotton this year.
- Electricity minister Abaza says national grid not affected by floods.
